description: Saves product facts the person knows, keyed by missingFacts[].key from create_product (e.g. dimensions, pack-count, key-ingredients), or corrects a fact read from the label. Values are printed word for word on the images and reused for every later set; an empty value removes a fact. Never make values up: ask the person, or skip (images are then made without those numbers). Free. Returns the product with updated facts and missingFacts. Example: {"product_id": "…", "facts": {"dimensions": "12 × 8 × 4 in (30.5 × 20.3 × 10.2 cm)"}}

facts.description: Fact key → value exactly as the person gave it (numbers and units unchanged), up to 20

name: answer_facts
title: Answer missing product facts
